title: Handle call status callbacks
summary: Receive ordered webhooks for initiated, ringing, answered, and completed call states, keyed by call ID.
scenario: A shop that calls customers when repairs are done and wants a record of what happened to each call

evidence: tools/openapi/compat.json POST Calls: StatusCallback, StatusCallbackEvent (valid values initiated, ringing, answered, completed, ringing_forwarded, ringing_queued; default completed), StatusCallbackMethod
tools/openapi/compat.json webhooks voice_status_callback: required fields, CallStatus enum, CallDuration only on completed, SequenceNumber starting at 0, best-effort
